context.body: A public royal procession reverses Adonijah’s private feast.

observations.body: David orders Solomon placed on the royal mule and anointed; the city rejoices while Adonijah’s gathering dissolves.
observations.label: Solomon is anointed at Gihon: action

observations.body: Solomon begins by sparing Adonijah conditionally and sending him home.
observations.label: Solomon is anointed at Gihon: response

observations.body: my mule · anoint · long live King Solomon · worthy man

payload.tension: Mercy is conditional on future conduct, leaving the rivalry unresolved.
